intro_messages.speaker: Urza Fastik
intro_messages.message: What’s this? Soldiers on the road from Tahn — that can only mean my brother Mathin is dead! Curses... the master should never have sent him here alongside me.
intro_messages.message_fr: Quoi encore ? Des soldats sur la route de Tahn — alors mon frère Mathin est mort ! Malédiction... le maître n'aurait jamais dû l'envoyer ici, à mes côtés.

intro_messages.speaker: Urza Fastik
intro_messages.message: I will avenge him. You fools will get no further, for I am second of the Urza brothers, and much more powerful than my late elder. Behold!
intro_messages.message_fr: Je vengerai sa mort. Pas un pas de plus, pauvres fous ! Je suis le deuxième de la fratrie Urza, et bien plus puissant que mon aîné. Voyez !

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: Another Urza brother, augmenting his ranks with the restless dead. The brothers must have been waiting on the road for travelers, ambushing civilians and raising their corpses as minions.
intro_messages.message_fr: Un autre frère Urza grossit ses rangs en relevant des morts. Les frères ont dû attendre des voyageurs sur la route, prenant en embuscade des civils et ranimant leurs cadavres comme mains d'œuvre.

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: I know banditry is not uncommon in the lawless south, but necromancy!? Where is the rest of the South Guard? How have things gotten so far out of control?
intro_messages.message_fr: Je sais que les bandits sont monnaie courante dans ce Sud sans foi ni loi, mais la nécromancie !? Où donc est le reste de la Garde du Sud ? Comment se fait-il que les choses aient dégénéré à ce point ?

intro_messages.speaker: Mari
intro_messages.message: Let’s find out. Deoran, you and your men deal with this bandit. Anyone who dies to those zombies will become one themselves, so don’t be stupid.
intro_messages.message_fr: Nous allons vite le savoir. Deoran, toi et tes hommes, occupez-vous de ces bandits. Quiconque meurt aux mains de ces zombis devient l'un d'entre eux, donc pas de bêtises.

intro_messages.speaker: Mari
intro_messages.message: Meanwhile, I’ll sneak past and get in contact with Westin — someone in town better know what’s going on here. If we’re lucky, I’ll return with reinforcements.
intro_messages.message_fr: Pendant ce temps, je vais me faufiler par derrière et entrer en contact avec Westin — il y aura bien quelqu'un là-bas qui sait ce qui ce passe ici. Avec un peu de chance, je serai de retour avec des renforts.

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: Going alone? That sounds dangerous. What happened to staying an observer?
intro_messages.message_fr: Vous partez seul ? Ça a l'air plutôt dangereux. Qu'est-il arrivé à l'observatrice passive ?

intro_messages.speaker: Deoran
intro_messages.message: Well then. I hope Mari returns with the rest of the South Guard, but I shouldn’t count on it. I may only be a junior commander, but this outlaw underestimates me if he thinks I can’t beat him on my own.
intro_messages.message_fr: Et bien. J'espère que Mari sera de retour avec le reste de la Garde du Sud, mais je ne devrais pas compter là-dessus. Je ne suis peut-être qu'un jeune officier, mais ce hors-la-loi me sous-estime si il pense que je ne peux pas le battre tout seul.

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message:
Good, we’ve captured a village! The little flag waving from it will serve as a reminder that it’s under our control. It will remain that way until an enemy moves into it.

 Each village we control provides upkeep and generates gold, which I can use to recruit new soldiers.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Ha, this zombie is so slow and weak! Usually, moving next to an enemy unit prevents me from moving any further. But this frail, feeble Walking Corpse is easy to outmaneuver.

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: Unlike most units, level 0 units (such as Walking Corpses) do not exert a Zone of Control. Your units can move freely around them.
I’m nearly blind in this nighttime gloom... If we don’t keep our distance from the undead, we’re going to get massacred!

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: Dawn breaks — the heroes grow strong while the villains grow weak. Men of the South Guard, now is our time to attack!

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Ah, excellent! The South Guard fights my warriors at night, when we are at our best! I am fortunate that their commander is so inexperienced.

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Idiot corpses, what are you doing? Don’t fight the South Guard during the day, when they’re at their best! ...how do I control these blasted things?

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Yes that’s right, you foolish South Guard commander! Fight waist-deep in the river while my bandits are safe in their encampments!

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: Most of your units have only a 20% chance to evade when standing in shallow water, while in encampment terrain most of the bandits have 60%. Fighting with your units on poor terrain isn’t always a bad idea, but it is often not worth the disadvantage to your troops.

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: If only it weren’t daytime, this would be the perfect fight for me...

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: And in the middle of the night too! This is the perfect fight for me!
My healing magic is potent, but I cannot use it to heal myself. I’ll have to spend some time in a village to recover.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I just made a ranged attack! I had to stand right next to this Quintain (yes, this is different from how most games handle ranged attacks), but because the dummy has no ranged weapon of its own it was unable to retaliate.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I just made a ranged attack! I had to stand right next to this $second_unit.language_name (yes, this is different from how most games handle ranged attacks), but because the $second_unit.language_name has no ranged weapon of its own it was unable to retaliate.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I just made a ranged attack! I had to stand right next to this $second_unit.language_name (yes, this is different from how most games handle ranged attacks), but because the $second_unit.language_name has no ranged weapon of his own he was unable to retaliate.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I missed all $consecutive_misses strikes! I tried my best, but this enemy had a high chance to evade. I might have had better odds attacking a different enemy.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: A good commander understands the odds, and knows how to both exploit good luck and mitigate bad luck. After all, both good and bad luck are equally likely!

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I got lucky and hit all $consecutive_hits strikes! Good luck will sometimes happen, but a good commander knows how to win without relying on it. After all, bad luck happens just as often as good luck!

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I missed all $consecutive_misses strikes, even though my enemy had a low chance to evade! That’s unlucky, but bad luck happens just as often as good luck — a good commander knows how to plan around both!

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I hit all $consecutive_hits strikes, even though my enemy had a high chance to evade! Luck works both ways — sometimes I miss strikes when I was likely to hit, but sometimes I also hit strikes that I was likely to miss — like now!

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Hey, that’s not fair! I spent ages fortifying the road, you can’t just go around!

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: I had better hurry and finish off this bandit! If I take too long he may decide to flee, and then I’ll never get the chance to find out what he knows!

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: We’ve caught you at last, you outlaw! Prepare to meet your end!

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Gah, more soldiers from Westin... Forget this, I’m getting out of here while I still have the chance!

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: He’s gone! Good work defeating these undead, Deoran, but their leader has escaped...

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Even with the power of darkness at my command... No, I can’t die yet! I— I can still escape!

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: Not so fast, outlaw — we’ve caught you at last! Time to clap you in irons.

a.speaker: Urza Fastik
a.message: Urgh! Get these chains... off me...

a.speaker: Mari
a.message: Minister, don’t let him die! This is our best chance to finally get some answers.

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: Mari, you’ve returned! And these must be the South Guard officers we were sent here to meet.

a.speaker: Minister Hylas
a.message: Minister Hylas, archivist and local medic. A pleasure to make your acquaintance, Lieutenant Deoran.

a.speaker: Sir Gerrick
a.message: Aye, an’ I’m Sir Gerrick, infantry commander o’ the South Guard! But now ain’t the time for talk — let’s get this prisoner back t’ town, and finally get some answers out o’ him.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I have failed my kingdom and duty...

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Yeah... I should’ve figured I wouldn’t get a happy ending...

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I have given all in service of my kingdom...

a.speaker: unit
a.message: May the Light guide you where I have failed...

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I have lost everything helping the humans... Now they will surely perish!

a.speaker: unit
a.message: I perish! Such wasted potential! I’d gained much experience, and was close to becoming something more...

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: One of your high-experience units has died! Take care to protect your experienced soldiers, so that they can eventually advance to powerful Level 2 veterans.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Argh, I fall! All my hard-won battle experience is lost! I will not be easy to replace, Deoran...

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: One of your high-level veterans has died! Take care to protect your promoted soldiers, so that you can recall them in future battles.

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: They’ve broken through the trapdoor and entered the refugee cellar! Even if we could still manage to win by force of arms, Westin is doomed without its people...

a.speaker: Deoran
a.message: Taste cold steel!

a.speaker: narrator
a.message:
One of your units has reached max XP, and has advanced a level! It is now significantly more powerful, and has been fully healed!

Every unit’s full description is shown in the info panel at the bottom of the screen.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Our bows and spears are nearly useless against these skeletons! They have nothing for our shafts to pierce but air!

a.speaker: narrator
a.message: Every unit’s damage resistances and vulnerabilities are shown in the info panel at the bottom of the screen.
